it doesn't seem like i'm able to delete the current task in my to-do list, what might be causing this issue?
The frontend has a Delete button, but the ID and backend lookup don’t match:
In index.html, the button calls deleteTask(task.id). Your task records come from MongoDB, where the database ID is _id
column2: the response may not include id, so the request can end up targeting /api/tasks/undefined.

column1: In routes/tasks.js, the DELETE route first runs getTask, which searches a local in-memory tasks array—not MongoDB. It can return 404 before the delete handler runs. The handler itself only removes an item from that local array, so it wouldn’t delete a database record anyway.
Use task._id in the button, and make the DELETE endpoint delete from MongoDB—for example, with Task.findByIdAndDelete(req.params.id). Check the browser’s Network tab when clicking Delete
column2: it should show a request to /api/tasks/<MongoDB _id>, not /api/tasks/undefined.
